description: This file contains platform-specific functions and configuration settings for upgrading and managing embedded devices in an OpenWrt-based system. It defines functions for image checking, upgrading, and configuration copying based on different hardware models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the image is valid for the current board, using specific legacy check functions for certain hardware.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a firmware upgrade appropriate for the specific hardware model, calling different functions based on the board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the device configuration depending on the hardware model.
